blocks.text: Breakfast. Full-day excursion to Valparaíso, 120 km towards the Pacific, through the Curacaví and Casablanca valleys, known for white wines such as Sauvignon Blanc. Built like an amphitheatre on its hills and linked by historic funiculars, Valparaíso, Chile’s main port, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site: visit Plaza Victoria, Plaza Sotomayor with the Monument to the Heroes of Iquique, and Paseo 21 de Mayo, overlooking the port and the ocean. Continue to Viña del Mar, Chile’s most popular resort, the “Garden City”, for lunch, a walk along the beach and the Quinta Vergara park, home of the International Song Festival. Return to Santiago.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport and fly to Calama. On arrival, transfer to San Pedro de Atacama.

Your introduction to the region begins in the Valley of the Moon, in the Cordillera de la Sal and part of the Los Flamencos National Reserve. Its rocks and arid landforms resemble the lunar surface. The afternoon brings views of the Andes and their volcanoes. At sunset, the desert turns shades of gold and red. After the excursion, transfer to your hotel and check in.

The Valley of the Moon is only a few kilometres from San Pedro de Atacama, so the change from a small village to an almost lifeless landscape is very quick. By evening, the sharp rocks of the Cordillera de la Sal, dry hollows and long shadows change shape and colour, with the line of Andean volcanoes behind them.
